scope.reviewed: Current four-module source diff and four test diffs, necessary surrounding source, and narrow existing foreground/worker shared-composition call sites.

assessment.subject: Exact selected original ingress
assessment.detail: Accepts only selected principal/source/evidence triples; no history search or nearby-turn inference. Source join requires exact conversation thread, INGRESS_COMMITTED sequence1, principal/conversation/message/project equality. Exact project including None and observation binding stay enforced.

assessment.subject: Current private authority and aliases
assessment.detail: Canonical owner and current admitted private bridge are the only subjects. Bridge sources remain tied to exact private chat; group/household scopes excluded. Existing read-only transaction checks current private owner authority in its separate authority namespace before reading conversation storage. Shared composition reloads bridge bindings for each lookup.

assessment.subject: Hash, erasure, retention and time
assessment.detail: Both queued source and original ingress canonical hashes are verified. Erased queue or ingress, expired retention, future event/source, foreign project, disallowed privacy class and invalid current authority do not supply raw source text. Source time is the original ingress event time, not recall time.

assessment.subject: Bounded raw source context
assessment.detail: First three distinct selected principal/source keys only; at most 4096 characters each, with explicit fragment marker and truncated flag. Deduplicates ingress and restores selected-source order. Missing original source does not become a fabricated quotation or trigger broad history retrieval.

assessment.subject: Raw-source cache revalidation
assessment.detail: Every semantic cache hit strips any prior original_source and resolves exact source authority again. Missing/revoked/erased/expired sources cannot leave old raw excerpts attached. Existing semantic recall remains separate. No second semantic recall or model call is introduced for enrichment.

assessment.subject: Preserved semantic selection and trust
assessment.detail: Uses selected fact provenance, validates resolver output against exact selected refs/project, and attaches each resolved source once. Derived fact text, rank, recall evidence and semantic trust remain unchanged. Failure adds no raw source and logs no private diagnostic contents.

assessment.subject: Shared foreground and worker composition
assessment.detail: Both existing routes call the same resource builder and receive the same bounded PostgreSQL source resolver. Existing identity, consent and alias resolvers remain intact; no new planner, memory store or execution route.

assessment.subject: Source intent, format and original time
assessment.detail: Renders exact permitted original text, source date/project and fragment qualifier adjacent to derived context. Explains source precedence for precise intent/format, constrains relative-time instructions to the source moment, and denies old action replay or expanded authority. This proves context transport, not that a future model obeys the complete feedback.

validation.reviewer: Static independent diff/context review and exact SHA256 binding; scoped git diff --check passes.
validation.countsQualification: 130 unique selected passing checks are implementer/root reports, including real disposable PostgreSQL16.13 source tests; not rerun by reviewer.
validation.disposableDatabaseStatus: Root reports closed; runtime database unused.
validation.actualSdkProjection: One existing owned SDK request projection with local transport is reported; not a paid provider request.

limitations: Merged semantic observations may expose one constituent source only; complete source reconstruction is not claimed.
At most three excerpts and explicit 4096-character fragments; complete text beyond the limit is not supplied.
Unavailable original source is omitted while semantic recall remains separate; this is not a new general privacy/stop audit.
Model-free source transport and local request projection do not prove improved later native formatting, time interpretation or full feedback use.
Development credit costs and complete Hindsight extraction usage remain unknown.
